title: The FTC says businesses must disclose when they use personalized pricing and it will "deploy enforcement resources" against companies that do not disclose it (Dave Michaels/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Dave Michaels / Wall Street Journal: The FTC says businesses must disclose when they use personalized pricing and it will “deploy enforcement resources” against companies that do not disclose it — Agency says businesses must disclose when they use personalized pricing and may face lawsuits if they don't
